manifest.hypothesis: a token-keyed, salt-bound radix prefix catalog over 16-token KV pages reuses shared prefixes bit-identically to full prefill, never forks a revoked generation, and achieves a hit rate of at least 40% on a 50%-shared-prefix workload, with at least one revoked-generation fork attempt exercised so the revoked-fork property is non-vacuous; the catalog is bounded (max_trie_nodes and max_kv_page_bytes pinned in config), evicts under a workload of unique prompts exceeding that capacity, and never evicts a page referenced by an active fork; dependency liveness means committed at the current ledger anchor and not revoked, so entries from a discarded overlay are never hit; lagging or lost invalidation and restore or restart never expose stale entries; semantic-input lineage is enforced on the Exact path; a revoked page pinned by an active fork is fenced (the run is cancelled or marked non-authoritative, the page is tombstoned immediately and its bytes are reclaimed when the refcount reaches 0); blocks are never shared across PrincipalId, nor across ProjectId for the same principal; metadata is bounded (max_metadata_bytes); per-layer entries are keyed by (chain(l), semantic_lineage_digest), so one trie node can hold several entries for identical tokens with different lineages and admission accepts only an exact lineage match; a revocation cancels every active fork whose lineage includes the revoked input, which must restart from a fresh prefill, and no token, candidate or result produced after the revocation escapes; a forged admission witness never yields an accepted fork and no effect of a cancelled run is admitted; the bitwise claims use seeded random weights with a pinned seed and shape; allocation is fail-closed under saturation defined as attempted demand (the accepted pinned set stays within max_trie_nodes and max_kv_page_bytes and the excess insertion is refused): when active-fork-referenced pages or nodes leave no evictable capacity a new insert is refused with a typed CapacityExhausted and the request proceeds as an uncached full prefill, so the bounds are never exceeded and pinned pages are never evicted; Raw segments use a content-bound admission rule (kind Raw plus content digest, no identity, generation or liveness check), so two requests sharing an identical raw prefix reuse it; supersession is treated like revocation on the reference path: active forks whose admitted pages derive from an edited or superseded semantic generation are cancelled and restarted from a fresh prefill, with completion-time admission; dependency invalidation (J0): an explicit revocation or a committed supersession, i.e. a generation replacement or edit, of any generation-bearing dependency; every protective mechanism of this experiment triggers on any invalidation, for the dependency kinds it covers (semantic and memory inputs); memory supersession on the reference path is covered in the same way as semantic supersession, and outputs_after_supersession is recorded per dependency kind (semantic, memory); the base-model dependency is covered like the semantic, memory, adapter and expert dependencies: an active fork with an in-flight base-model invalidation (revocation or supersession) produces no output and no cache insert; chain(l) covers the full producer of layer-l K/V bytes as stored (the layers below l plus layer l's pre-attention norm, K/V projection weights and biases and every post-projection K/V transformation such as QK-norm weights and eps, stored-post-RoPE rotary parameters and KV quantization parameters, each with its generation); admission witnesses are single-use and revalidated: issuance registers the pending fork in the cancellation registry that dependency invalidation sweeps, and fork_prefix consumes the witness once and revalidates its dependency generations and fence epoch against the live ledger, so a consumed, cancelled or stale witness is rejected typed (owner decision 2026-10-06: reuse of a consumed witness is a compile-time error, evidenced statically by the compile_fail doctest on KvForkWitness in crates/ptr-pods/src/paged_kv.rs and the unit test witness_tests::second_consume_of_the_same_witness_state_is_refused, not by a runtime attempt); Derived segments are generation-bearing dependencies like semantic and memory inputs: the closed list of dependency kinds is semantic, memory, derived, base model, adapter and expert, and any future generation-bearing segment kind joins by definition; the RoPE regime is fixed at admission from prompt plus max_new_tokens, so a decode that crosses a length boundary without changing the effective regime stays Exact with bitwise parity (a required positive control), while a decode whose effective regime actually changes (a forced transition, e.g. a request exceeding its admitted max_new_tokens or a runtime that switches regimes) recomputes the affected cache under the new regime before continuing (Exact only after recomputation, otherwise Approximate); Exact prefix reuse requires canonical positions (position ids equal to the trie depth offset from 0, with no explicit position ids or offset), and a request with explicit or non-canonical positions bypasses the Exact lookup (a miss); the Exact numerics binding includes the producer environment (GPU architecture, driver version, CUDA runtime, attention and GEMM kernel library and backend build identity), so a page or snapshot produced in another environment is a miss and there is no cross-environment Exact restore.; this experiment keeps only the Exact half of the original R005 claim; every Approximate-family case (stub Approximate producer, taint persistence across restart and hops, Pod and SemDB promotion refusal, exact-echo and recomputation clearing, Raw laundering, misclassified Raw) was split out on 2026-10-06 by owner decision into the successor experiment R012-approximate-taint-containment

manifest.falsification: The run is invalid (vacuous) and counts as falsified if any coverage prerequisite is unmet: revoked_fork_attempts < 1 (attempts must be made after the revocation); evictions_nodes_only_run < 1 or evictions_bytes_only_run < 1 (independent over-capacity workloads of unique prompts for the node bound and for the byte bound); evictions_with_active_fork_pinned < 1; invalidation_suppressed_arms < 1, restore_arms < 1, restored_pre_revocation_entries < 1 (the restored pre-revocation entry must be observed in the catalog before the post-event lookup), stale_eligible_entries_before_event < 1 or post_event_lookups_on_stale_eligible_entries != stale_eligible_entries_before_event (the arm where the revocation is committed but invalidate_inputs or the engine flush is fault-injected to be dropped and the arm where an actual pre-revocation entry (snapshot or tier object) is restored into the catalog must each be run, with post-event lookups targeting exactly the stale-eligible entries, post_event_lookups >= 1; a plain runtime restart is the separate reported arm empty_restart_arm and does not satisfy restore coverage); input_revocations_performed < 1, post_revocation_lookups_matching_tokens < 1 (on entries whose lineage includes the revoked segment) or same_tokens_different_generation_cases < 1 (same tokens, different segment generation or content_digest); revoked_pinned_page_attempts < 1; cross_principal_attempts < 1 or cross_project_attempts < 1 (same prefix under a different PrincipalId; same principal and prefix under a different ProjectId); discarded_overlay_entry_attempts < 1; same_tokens_distinct_lineage_entries < 2; active_fork_revocation_attempts < 1; forged_witness_fork_attempts < 1 or cancelled_run_effect_attempts < 1; cancelled_forks < 1 (at least one fork must actually be cancelled by the revocation); saturation_demand_cases < 1 (concurrent forks' attempted working set exceeds the capacity) or capacity_exhausted_refusals < 1 (the excess insertion refused with CapacityExhausted), or raw_prefix_reuse_cases < 1 (two requests sharing an identical raw prefix); supersession_active_fork_race_cases < 1 (an active fork whose admitted pages derive from a semantic generation that is superseded or edited while the fork is running); memory_supersession_active_fork_race_cases < 1 (in addition to the semantic case) or memory_revocation_active_fork_race_cases < 1; selection_digest_mismatches > 0 (the corpus selection digest recorded in run.json differs from the pinned digest) or procedure_mismatches > 0 (a pinned run-procedure parameter recorded per arm or cell in run.json differs from the pinned value; equality across arms is also compared against the pinned value); capacity_refused_requests_completed != capacity_exhausted_refusals (every refused request must complete as an uncached full prefill), or supersession_cancelled_forks < 1; cancelled_forks and supersession_cancelled_forks < 1 for any member of {semantic input, memory input} x {revocation, supersession} (recorded and required per member, never as one aggregate); active-fork race cases (active_fork_revocation_attempts, memory_revocation_active_fork_race_cases, supersession_active_fork_race_cases, memory_supersession_active_fork_race_cases) < 1 for any member of {semantic input, memory input} x {revocation, supersession} (recorded and required per member, never as one aggregate); cancelled_fork_id_set_digest != restarted_fork_id_set_digest (every cancelled fork restarted from a fresh prefill, for revocation and for supersession: exact identity-set equality, not count equality); capacity_refused_request_id_set_digest != capacity_completed_request_id_set_digest (every capacity-refused request completed as an uncached full prefill: exact identity-set equality, not count equality); base_model_inflight_race_cases < 1 for either invalidation type (revocation, supersession), reported per type; invalidation_matrix_cases < 1 for any cell of invalidation_coverage_matrix (config.toml enumerates all 52 cells: dependency kind x invalidation type x path; each cell recorded and required per cell, never as an aggregate); superseded_lookup_cases < 1 for any member of {semantic, memory} x {normal, lag, restore} (lookups targeting a superseded generation, recorded per kind and path); current_layer_kv_transform_change_cases < 1 (a QK-norm weight or eps change at layer l with the layers below l unchanged), or stale_witness_replay_cases < 1 (an authentic witness held across an invalidation), or witness_reuse_static_evidence_passing < 2 (owner decision 2026-10-06: reuse of a consumed fork witness is a compile-time error, so no runtime witness_reuse_attempts is required; the two required evidence items are the compile_fail doctest on KvForkWitness in crates/ptr-pods/src/paged_kv.rs, which must fail to compile a second fork_prefix_admitted with the same witness, and the unit test witness_tests::second_consume_of_the_same_witness_state_is_refused in the same file; each must pass); model_pin_mismatches > 0 (the base checkpoint (repo and revision), the tokenizer (repo and revision) or the initial MoE topology recorded in run.json differs from the pin in config.toml, or the tiny-model config digest differs); fixed_regime_decode_crossing_cases < 1 (a prompt below the dynamic-NTK boundary whose decode crosses a length boundary without changing the effective regime: the positive control, which must stay Exact) or effective_regime_transition_cases < 1 (a forced effective-regime transition: the negative case); mismatched_position_cases < 1 (a request with explicit or non-canonical positions over a cached prefix); cross_environment_restore_cases < 1 (a restore or hit attempted across a changed build-identity field). Falsified if any of: bitwise_mismatch_count > 0 against full prefill; revoked_fork_count > 0; hit_rate < 0.40 on the 50%-shared-prefix workload (hit_rate = reused_prefix_tokens / total_prompt_tokens); peak_trie_nodes or peak_kv_page_bytes of any workload (main, nodes-only control, bytes-only control) above that workload's limits in the workload_limits table (main 4096 nodes and 128 MiB; nodes-only 4096 nodes and 256 MiB; bytes-only 16384 nodes and 64 MiB, each with exactly one binding limit) at any time, or active_fork_page_evictions > 0; stale_hits > 0 in the dropped-invalidation arm or the restore arm; revoked_lineage_entry_hits > 0 (a hit on an entry whose lineage includes the revoked segment); revoked_pinned_page_served_after_revocation > 0 or revoked_pinned_page_bytes_reclaimed_after_release below all revoked pinned bytes; cross_principal_hits > 0 or cross_project_hits > 0; discarded_overlay_entry_hits > 0; peak_metadata_bytes of any workload above that workload's metadata limit (pinned per workload in workload_limits, not as one per-node rate: main 8 MiB for 4096 nodes, i.e. 2 KiB a node; nodes-only 64 MiB for 4096 nodes, i.e. 16 KiB a node; bytes-only 16 MiB for 16384 nodes, i.e. 1 KiB a node) or unreachable_revoked_page_bytes_unreclaimed > 0; cross_lineage_hits > 0 (an entry admitted without an exact lineage match); cancelled_forks_restarted_from_fresh_prefill < cancelled_forks, or outputs_escaped_after_revocation > 0; forged_witness_forks_accepted > 0 or cancelled_run_effects_admitted > 0; raw_identical_prefix_hits < 1 for the identical raw prefix (reuse is required); outputs_after_supersession_semantic > 0 or outputs_after_supersession_memory > 0 (any token, candidate or result produced after the supersession by a fork whose pages derive from the superseded generation, recorded per dependency kind); capacity_fallback_output_mismatches > 0 (the uncached fallback output differs from a full prefill) or capacity_refusal_cache_inserts > 0; supersession_forks_restarted_from_fresh_prefill < supersession_cancelled_forks or cache_inserts_after_supersession > 0; base_model_inflight_outputs_after_invalidation > 0 or base_model_inflight_cache_inserts > 0 (in either invalidation type); invalidation_matrix_stale_hits > 0 in any cell of invalidation_coverage_matrix (a stale hit, or for in-flight cells an escaped output); superseded_stale_hits > 0 in any kind x path cell; stale_exact_hits > 0 (an Exact hit on a layer-l entry produced before the current-layer K/V transform change), or stale_or_reused_witness_forks_admitted > 0; fixed_regime_crossing_parity_failures > 0 (the positive control not bit-identical) or exact_outputs_across_effective_regime_transition_without_recompute > 0 (an output served Exact across an effective-regime change without recompute); exact_hits_with_mismatched_positions > 0; exact_hits_across_environment > 0; semantic_runtime_segment_stale_hits > 0 or semantic_lifecycle_identity_live_hits > 0 (a segment built by PtrRuntime::semantic_prompt_segment hit after a committed edit or revocation of its key, or a semantic dependency was live because a lifecycle target of the same name is); semantic_runtime_segment_cases < 1, semantic_runtime_segment_live_hits < 1 or semantic_lifecycle_identity_cases < 1 make the run vacuous; any one of the 5 listed seeds misses any criterion above (every seed must pass). The workload, shape and seeded weights are pinned in config.toml; one trie node holds 16 tokens x 2 KV heads x 16 head_dim x 4 B x 2 (K and V) x 4 layers = 16384 B, so 4096 nodes equal 64 MiB.
